method: Transfer the original QuPath snapshot's visible 50 µm scale bar to its unresized crop. No raw-slide ROI transform is required.
measurement_precision: 79-pixel rasterized source bar. Effective pixel calibration is derived from that rendered width, not asserted to be the full-precision raw-slide calibration.
output_policy: Preserve every crop pixel and the existing orientation. Add the scale bar in a separate black footer, not over tissue. PDF bar and Arial label are vector.
